column6: Activity
The Rocks self-guided walk — Historic laneways; oldest pubs; Rocks Discovery Museum; weekend markets
Circular Quay → Opera House → Botanic Garden → Mrs Macquarie's Chair — 2-3hr waterfront loop
Opera House guided tour — 1hr interior tour
Opera House backstage tour — Go onstage; dressing rooms; behind the scenes
Taronga Zoo + ferry combo — Ferry across harbour + zoo entry; koalas; kangaroos
Bondi → Coogee coastal walk — 6km; cliffs; Tamarama; Bronte; rock pools
Bondi → Coogee guided walk — Same route + guide + lunch at Coogee Bay Hotel
Ferry to Manly + Manly Beach — 30-min ferry; harbour views; walk to Shelly Beach
Watsons Bay + Camp Cove + South Head walk — Swim Camp Cove; walk to Hornby Lighthouse
BridgeClimb — Climb to summit of the Harbour Bridge; day/twilight/dawn options
Harbour Hop-On Hop-Off ferry — All-day pass: Circular Quay; Darling Harbour; Taronga; Watsons Bay; Manly
Cockatoo Island — UNESCO convict site + shipyard ruins
DIY train to Katoomba — Three Sisters; Giant Stairway; Prince Henry Cliff Walk (7km); Wentworth Falls
Scenic World — Steepest railway; Skyway glass-floor cable car (270m); rainforest boardwalk
All-inclusive guided day tour — Hotel pickup; Featherdale Wildlife; Three Sisters; Scenic World; lunch; ferry return
Active / backpacker tour — More hiking-focused; fewer tourist stops
Private tour + wildlife + ferry return — Smaller group; flexible; wildlife park + Parramatta River cruise
Airlie Beach Lagoon — Free public pool on waterfront; swim; lounge; explore main strip
Bicentennial Walkway — Flat waterfront path; lagoon to Cannonvale; Pioneer Bay views
Boathaven Beach — Quiet local beach; good for sunset
Sunset Sail — 2hr evening cruise; sparkling wine + snacks; schooner; departs 5pm
Ocean Rafting — Southern Lights — Full day; more beach at Whitehaven + Hill Inlet; only operator with direct Hill Inlet beach drop
Ocean Rafting — Northern Exposure — Full day; two snorkel sites; less beach time
Cruise Whitsundays catamaran — Larger boat; smoother ride; Whitehaven + snorkel; less adventurous
Cruise Whitsundays — Hardy Reef (outer reef) — Full day; Reefworld pontoon 39nm offshore; snorkel gear; underwater observatory; lunch
Fly + Raft combo — Scenic flight Heart Reef + Ocean Rafting Whitehaven in one day
Scenic flight — Heart Reef aerial — 1hr over Heart Reef; Whitehaven; Hill Inlet; GBR
Jet ski island tour — Guided jet ski to South Molle + Daydream Islands; no license needed
Crocodile Safari — Proserpine River cruise; spot wild crocs; tractor wagon; BBQ lunch
Honeyeater Lookout hike — 8.2km return; panoramic views of Airlie + ocean + islands
Mt Rooper Circuit — 7.2km bushwalk; Conway National Park; harbour + island views
Beak Lookout + Coral Beach — 3.9km trail; subtropical forest; rocky beach + panoramic lookout
Sunset Sail — 2hr evening cruise (if not done Day 4)
Chill day — Lagoon; Boathaven Beach; walk the strip; day drink
Darling Harbour walk — Waterfront stroll; bars; dining
The Rocks Markets (Saturday) — Weekend markets; food; crafts; art
Harbour tall ship twilight dinner cruise — Evening sail + dinner; nice farewell
Barangaroo dinner — A'Mare (Italian fine dining); Watermans (wood-fired Mediterranean)
Newtown / Enmore — Eclectic neighborhood; cheap eats; indie bars; Thai + Vietnamese
